Link your GitHub username to receive review requests in your activity inbox.

Notifications

Choose which updates land in your activity inbox. Turning one off never hides the page where the work lives.

GitHub review requests
Inbox items when a pull request asks for your review.
Agent approval requests
Inbox items when an agent needs your approval. Requests stay on the approvals page.
Agent work assignments
Inbox items for work assigned by an agent.
Event reminders
Inbox reminders before events you are attending. Push reminders still go out.
Huddle invitations
Inbox items for incoming huddles. The incoming-call banner still shows.
Calls

With voice activity your microphone is live whenever you are unmuted. With push-to-talk it opens only while you hold the key — never while you are typing.

Status

Automatic shows you online while you're here and idle after 10 quiet minutes. Your custom status shows beside your name.

Meetings

Google Calendar is not configured for this workspace

Out of office

Show "Out of office" beside your name until the end you pick. It clears itself when the end passes, and wins over a custom status, DND, and the meeting label.

in your time zone

Google Calendar is not configured for this workspace

Do not disturb

While DND is on, push notifications and sounds stay silent. Your inbox still records everything.

Do not disturb
Silence push and sounds until you turn this off.
Quiet hours
Scheduled DND every day, in your time zone.
Do not disturb during meetings
Silence push and sounds while you're in a meeting. Only works while "Show when I'm in a meeting" is on; starred people still get through.
Keep notifying me while I'm out of office
Off means push, sounds, and huddle rings stay silent while you're out of office, like DND. Starred people still get through; your inbox still records everything.

Star people from their profile page to let their messages through DND.

Keyword alerts

One word or phrase per line, up to 20. A match in any room you belong to lands in your inbox.

Link your GitHub username to receive review requests in your activity inbox.

Notifications

Choose which updates land in your activity inbox. Turning one off never hides the page where the work lives.

GitHub review requests
Inbox items when a pull request asks for your review.
Agent approval requests
Inbox items when an agent needs your approval. Requests stay on the approvals page.
Agent work assignments
Inbox items for work assigned by an agent.
Event reminders
Inbox reminders before events you are attending. Push reminders still go out.
Huddle invitations
Inbox items for incoming huddles. The incoming-call banner still shows.
Calls

With voice activity your microphone is live whenever you are unmuted. With push-to-talk it opens only while you hold the key — never while you are typing.

Status

Automatic shows you online while you're here and idle after 10 quiet minutes. Your custom status shows beside your name.

Meetings

Out of office

Show "Out of office" beside your name until the end you pick. It clears itself when the end passes, and wins over a custom status, DND, and the meeting label.

in your time zone

Do not disturb

While DND is on, push notifications and sounds stay silent. Your inbox still records everything.

Do not disturb
Silence push and sounds until you turn this off.
Quiet hours
Scheduled DND every day, in your time zone.
Do not disturb during meetings
Silence push and sounds while you're in a meeting. Only works while "Show when I'm in a meeting" is on; starred people still get through.
Keep notifying me while I'm out of office
Off means push, sounds, and huddle rings stay silent while you're out of office, like DND. Starred people still get through; your inbox still records everything.

Star people from their profile page to let their messages through DND.

One word or phrase per line, up to 20. A match in any room you belong to lands in your inbox.

Link your GitHub username to receive review requests in your activity inbox.

Notifications

Choose which updates land in your activity inbox. Turning one off never hides the page where the work lives.

GitHub review requests
Inbox items when a pull request asks for your review.
Agent approval requests
Inbox items when an agent needs your approval. Requests stay on the approvals page.
Agent work assignments
Inbox items for work assigned by an agent.
Event reminders
Inbox reminders before events you are attending. Push reminders still go out.
Huddle invitations
Inbox items for incoming huddles. The incoming-call banner still shows.
Calls

With voice activity your microphone is live whenever you are unmuted. With push-to-talk it opens only while you hold the key — never while you are typing.

Status

Automatic shows you online while you're here and idle after 10 quiet minutes. Your custom status shows beside your name.

in your time zone

Do not disturb

While DND is on, push notifications and sounds stay silent. Your inbox still records everything.

Do not disturb
Silence push and sounds until you turn this off.
Quiet hours
Scheduled DND every day, in your time zone.
Do not disturb during meetings
Silence push and sounds while you're in a meeting. Only works while "Show when I'm in a meeting" is on; starred people still get through.
Keep notifying me while I'm out of office
Off means push, sounds, and huddle rings stay silent while you're out of office, like DND. Starred people still get through; your inbox still records everything.

Link your GitHub username to receive review requests in your activity inbox.

Notifications

Choose which updates land in your activity inbox. Turning one off never hides the page where the work lives.

GitHub review requests
Inbox items when a pull request asks for your review.
Agent approval requests
Inbox items when an agent needs your approval. Requests stay on the approvals page.
Agent work assignments
Inbox items for work assigned by an agent.
Event reminders
Inbox reminders before events you are attending. Push reminders still go out.
Huddle invitations
Inbox items for incoming huddles. The incoming-call banner still shows.
Calls

With voice activity your microphone is live whenever you are unmuted. With push-to-talk it opens only while you hold the key — never while you are typing.

Status

Automatic shows you online while you're here and idle after 10 quiet minutes. Your custom status shows beside your name.

Meetings

Google Calendar is not configured for this workspace

Out of office

Show "Out of office" beside your name until the end you pick. It clears itself when the end passes, and wins over a custom status, DND, and the meeting label.

in your time zone

Google Calendar is not configured for this workspace

Do not disturb

While DND is on, push notifications and sounds stay silent. Your inbox still records everything.

Do not disturb
Silence push and sounds until you turn this off.
Quiet hours
Scheduled DND every day, in your time zone.
Do not disturb during meetings
Silence push and sounds while you're in a meeting. Only works while "Show when I'm in a meeting" is on; starred people still get through.
Keep notifying me while I'm out of office
Off means push, sounds, and huddle rings stay silent while you're out of office, like DND. Starred people still get through; your inbox still records everything.

Star people from their profile page to let their messages through DND.

Keyword alerts

One word or phrase per line, up to 20. A match in any room you belong to lands in your inbox.

Notifications

Choose which updates land in your activity inbox. Turning one off never hides the page where the work lives.

GitHub review requests
Inbox items when a pull request asks for your review.
Agent approval requests
Inbox items when an agent needs your approval. Requests stay on the approvals page.
Agent work assignments
Inbox items for work assigned by an agent.
Event reminders
Inbox reminders before events you are attending. Push reminders still go out.
Huddle invitations
Inbox items for incoming huddles. The incoming-call banner still shows.
Calls

With voice activity your microphone is live whenever you are unmuted. With push-to-talk it opens only while you hold the key — never while you are typing.

Status

Automatic shows you online while you're here and idle after 10 quiet minutes. Your custom status shows beside your name.

in your time zone

Do not disturb

While DND is on, push notifications and sounds stay silent. Your inbox still records everything.

Do not disturb
Silence push and sounds until you turn this off.
Quiet hours
Scheduled DND every day, in your time zone.
Do not disturb during meetings
Silence push and sounds while you're in a meeting. Only works while "Show when I'm in a meeting" is on; starred people still get through.
Keep notifying me while I'm out of office
Off means push, sounds, and huddle rings stay silent while you're out of office, like DND. Starred people still get through; your inbox still records everything.

Choose which updates land in your activity inbox. Turning one off never hides the page where the work lives.

Agent approval requests

Event reminders
Inbox reminders before events you are attending. Push reminders still go out.
Huddle invitations
Inbox items for incoming huddles. The incoming-call banner still shows.
Calls

With voice activity your microphone is live whenever you are unmuted. With push-to-talk it opens only while you hold the key — never while you are typing.

Silence push and sounds until you turn this off.

Silence push and sounds while you're in a meeting. Only works while "Show when I'm in a meeting" is on; starred people still get through.

Link your GitHub username to receive review requests in your activity inbox.

Notifications

Choose which updates land in your activity inbox. Turning one off never hides the page where the work lives.

GitHub review requests
Inbox items when a pull request asks for your review.
Agent approval requests
Inbox items when an agent needs your approval. Requests stay on the approvals page.
Agent work assignments
Inbox items for work assigned by an agent.
Event reminders
Inbox reminders before events you are attending. Push reminders still go out.
Huddle invitations
Inbox items for incoming huddles. The incoming-call banner still shows.
Calls

With voice activity your microphone is live whenever you are unmuted. With push-to-talk it opens only while you hold the key — never while you are typing.

Status

Automatic shows you online while you're here and idle after 10 quiet minutes. Your custom status shows beside your name.

Meetings

Google Calendar is not configured for this workspace

Out of office

Show "Out of office" beside your name until the end you pick. It clears itself when the end passes, and wins over a custom status, DND, and the meeting label.

in your time zone

Do not disturb

While DND is on, push notifications and sounds stay silent. Your inbox still records everything.

Do not disturb
Silence push and sounds until you turn this off.
Quiet hours
Scheduled DND every day, in your time zone.
Do not disturb during meetings
Silence push and sounds while you're in a meeting. Only works while "Show when I'm in a meeting" is on; starred people still get through.
Keep notifying me while I'm out of office
Off means push, sounds, and huddle rings stay silent while you're out of office, like DND. Starred people still get through; your inbox still records everything.

Star people from their profile page to let their messages through DND.

Notifications

Choose which updates land in your activity inbox. Turning one off never hides the page where the work lives.

GitHub review requests
Inbox items when a pull request asks for your review.
Agent approval requests
Inbox items when an agent needs your approval. Requests stay on the approvals page.
Agent work assignments
Inbox items for work assigned by an agent.
Event reminders
Inbox reminders before events you are attending. Push reminders still go out.
Huddle invitations
Inbox items for incoming huddles. The incoming-call banner still shows.
Calls

With voice activity your microphone is live whenever you are unmuted. With push-to-talk it opens only while you hold the key — never while you are typing.

Status

Automatic shows you online while you're here and idle after 10 quiet minutes. Your custom status shows beside your name.
